crossRefs.note: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you…
So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.
If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any…
But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.
But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.
But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.
Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject…

translations.web: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
translations.bsb: Let us not become conceited, provoking and envying one another.
translations.kjv: Let us not be desirous of vain glory, provoking one another, envying one another.
translations.asv: Let us not become vainglorious, provoking one another, envying one another.
